newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap H1 net attrib profit 136 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Cap H1 net attrib profit 136 mln Ffr.

text.p: (Figures in millions of francs unless stated)
NOTE - Cap Gemini Sogeti said in a statement with its first-half results net attributable profit for the full year 1996 should show a clear advance from the 52 million francs made in 1995.
It said excluding write-down of goodwill, first-half net attributable profit of 136 million francs was 2.7 times its result a year ago.
Taking into account the write-down of goodwill, the group's results went to a net attributable profit of 84 million francs from a 19 million loss a year ago.
It said the second half should confirm the improving trend in operating margins in computing services and Gemini Consulting.
